    • getSupplierCompletionContext

      public static SupplierCompletionContext getSupplierCompletionContext(SupplierSourceContext context)

      Safely obtains the SupplierCompletionContext from the SupplierSourceContext.

      This aids in testing of SupplierCompileCompletion.

      Parameters:
      context - SupplierSourceContext.
      Returns:
      SupplierCompletionContext corresponding to the SupplierSourceContext.
